name: Look up member and read savings balance
description: Search for a member by ID and read their current savings balance from the member detail page.

discovery.goal_text: Look up member {member_id} and read their current savings balance.

input_params.name: member_id
input_params.description: The member ID to look up.

output_params.name: savings_balance
output_params.description: The member's current savings balance as displayed on the page.
